routines.name: MMA + Arms
routines.subtitle: 30 min light

items.cue: Isolation work — the metabolite stimulus IS the point here.
Superset with A1. Last set is a drop set.

routines.note: Do this AFTER MMA, never before. Three days clear of Saturday.

items.cue: Progress reps, then a 3 s eccentric. Plates only once 4x12 is clean and weight is down.
Density driver. Chest-supported means zero lower-back cost before Friday MMA.
Full stretch at the bottom. Straps if grip is MMA-fatigued.
Superset with B1. Shoulder insurance.

routines.name: MMA + Chest & Delts
routines.subtitle: 30 min light

items.cue: 10-15 at RIR 2 (~60-65 kg). 18-20 reps is local endurance — high joint cycles for little tension.
Superset with A1. Stays 15-20, taken to failure.

routines.note: Do this AFTER MMA, never before.

routines.name: Arm Day
routines.subtitle: Triceps · Biceps — the priority session

items.cue: THE arm-size lift. Triceps are two thirds of the arm. Currently 30 kg — climb it.
The long head only grows stretched. This builds the horseshoe.
Last set is a drop set. This is your metabolite work.
Hold 17.5 kg until 10 reps across 4 sets, then move to 20 kg. No hip drive.
PEAK BUILDER. Arm behind the torso — the closest thing to a peak lift.
Front-on arm width. Slow negative.
